meta.goal: Design a minimal REST API in Python (FastAPI) for a task management app: endpoints for creating, listing, updating, and deleting tasks, with in-memory storage.
meta.initial_state: We are starting from scratch. No code exists yet. The API must support: POST /tasks (create), GET /tasks (list all), PATCH /tasks/{id} (update), DELETE /tasks/{id} (delete). Storage is in-memory (a Python dict). No auth required.
